blockers.title: GitHub write primitive: contract's non-forced ref PATCH versus R2's guarded GraphQL commit
blockers.owner: Owner-authored record (Ordo decision or owner commit to an OWNER-DECISIONS addendum) naming DEC-006 and F-009; agents do not write it (RDP-003, AR-003)
blockers.recommendation: (a) for Rehearsal 4 and the event; (b) after the event. (a) changes no data format, schema identity or fixture, needs no upstream release, and keeps optimistic concurrency (the decision's base commit stays the concurrency token, a moved head is refused and handled as a conflict). The exact amendment text is in readiness/CONTRACT-RESOLUTION.md.

blockers.title: User authentication mechanism for the connect flow
blockers.owner: Owner decision record (security boundary); F-019 and F-012 close with it
blockers.recommendation: (a), with a credential required for every connection (no anonymous mode: Rehearsal 3 hit GitHub's exhausted anonymous quota). It needs no service, works in iPad Safari (plain fetch with an Authorization header; api.github.com answers Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *), and keeps least privilege. The CI live job uses the separate CAUSA_GITHUB_TOKEN Actions secret, never the browser path.
